list.title: Claims
list.intro: Got a settlement letter with deductions? Kavach checks each one against your policy and the IRDAI rules.

steps.match: Finding the patient and the policy
steps.check: Checking each deduction against the policy

check.icuLabel: Part of the stay was in ICU

appeal.title: Appeal letter
appeal.verified: Checked: every amount matches the engine and every quote matches your policy
appeal.failed: Fix these before the PDF can be made
appeal.blocked: The PDF is blocked until every check passes.

ladder.three: Insurance Ombudsman, within one year of the insurer’s reply
